page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is configured with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, and it delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 8 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average-tier performance across compute and memory operations. The processor achieved a single-core stress-ng score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19, supported by a PassMark CPU score of 23637.6. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1282.13 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 109.43 GB/sec for uncached large blocks, alongside a write speed of 48.03 GB/sec. For database workloads, the instance processed 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and scored 8647.45 on PassMark database operations. In language model inference, the server processed 1294.61 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M model, dropping to 34.44 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

The dedicated CPU allocation with one thread per core ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring stable CPU execution. However, the lack of bundled local storage requires external block storage attachments, which may introduce latency and additional cost considerations. This instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, static web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations.
